product.name: Howo Mini Tipper Truck
product.description: The new Howo Mini Tipper Truck with single axle has commercial vehicle experience on board. Whether you are on a construction site, in a farm, or transporting garbage, it will get to grips with almost any terrain easily.

detailedFeatures.Mini tipper truck cab: 2080 mini tipper truck cabin single and half row.
detailedFeatures.Mini tipper truck Gearbox: 6 speed gear, option 10 speed with high and low gear.
